beforeSend.title: onBeforeSendMessage Hook
beforeSend.description: Inject contextual data into messages before sending. Select a category and send a message to see the payload injection.

customHeader.title: Custom Header
customHeader.description: Demonstrates onMessageSent callback and renderHeader prop to build a custom header with message counter.

autoReset.title: Auto Reset Channel
autoReset.description: Control whether the channel is automatically reset on mount. When disabled, history messages from initMessages are preserved without sending RESET_CHANNEL.
autoReset.enabledBehavior: Channel will be reset on mount (sends RESET_CHANNEL action). This is the default behavior.
autoReset.disabledBehavior: Channel is created without sending RESET_CHANNEL. History messages from initMessages are preserved, and new messages can still be sent.
